The last couple of months I’ve had the opportunity to speak with many HR managers. Not just about their challenges, but also about where they see opportunities. posts.content:
HUG; the event that just had everything! The right- crowd, lineup, venue & HR insights. 

I had the pleasure to host a workshop about "Data Driven vs Data Informed decision making" (thanks Patrick Klink for the inspiration 😉). We looked at the differences between the two approaches and when to use which. The key takeaways: 
1. There is no magic formula; you'll have to choose based on your context. But do understand: adding personal experience and gut feeling generally doesn't hurt the outcome.
2. Find it difficult to choose an approach? Discuss with peers outside your context but sit at the same side of the table as you do. Two minds know more than one! 
3. Interactive workshops are the best place to expand your network. Guess what: that's what HUG is all about 🙌

You couldn't make it to HUG on Tour 2022 by Personio or you would like to re-watch one of your favorite sessions? No problem! Just register here and you will get access to all videos on-demand: https://lnkd.in/e8yj65Wz
